newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco bourse closes up, building on rising trend.
newsitem.headline: Morocco bourse closes up, building on rising trend.

text.p: Morocco's stock exchange closed 1.23 percent higher on Tuesday, building on gains started late last week, brokers said.
The Casablanca bourse all-share index closed at 632.89 points, up from 625.18 points on Monday.
"People seem to be gaining confidence so there is strong demand for shares," a broker at BMCI Securities said.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc rose 24 dirhams to 845 dirhams and Wafabank gained 23 dirhams to 805 dirhams, with 5,714 shares changing hands.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, was up 17 dirhams to 594 dirhams.
Conglomerate ONA Group was unchanged at 760 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement was up 21 dirhams to 742 dirhams, with 10,767 shares changing hands.
In the energy sector, oil refinery Samir was up 6.50 dirhams at 346.00 dirhams, with 25,319 shares exchanged.
Steel mill Sonasid rose 15 dirhams to 547 dirhams.
Credit firms also contributed, with Credit Eqdom up 47 dirhams at 999 dirhams and Credor at 723 dirhams, up 21 dirhams over the previous session.
Total traded volume on the official market was 97.6 million dirhams compared with 36 million dirhams on Monday.
On the over-the-counter market, volume was down to 63 million dirhams from 147 million dirhams over the previous day. Main trade on this market was in 25,400 ONA's shares.
